introduction_transcript: Welcome to Journey Six, Lesson Six: Submit the Portfolio and Execution Plan. Bring your six journey results, finished bounded artifact, tests, revisions, demonstration, responsible statement, and positioning set. Use PROGRESS Closeout: portfolio, review, ownership, gaps, roadmap, evidence, support, and sustain. Assemble the strongest required evidence from your existing work. Create a new version only to correct a real issue. Explain your growth through a changed decision and an improved result supported by evidence. Build a thirty-, sixty-, and ninety-day plan with actions, owners or collaborators, needed permissions, and evidence checkpoints. Our fictional example schedules a permitted pilot, quality review, and conditional decision about wider use. It does not declare success in advance. Check privacy-safe evidence, sources, versions, human decisions, and final files. Deliver the final demonstration, answer review questions, and resolve missing evidence through focused revision. Submit the index, artifact, responsible statement, positioning set, and continuation plan by Sunday of Week Six. An authorized academy reviewer decides credentials using the governing rubric. AI may help identify gaps; it cannot decide certification. Open your connected workbook and complete this final lesson.
